description:
Read-only audit log of the organization and its workspaces: list events a page at a time, or export them as JSON lines. Organization admins only. Events never hold secrets, codes or anything that identifies a head.

Pass action: one of list, export. Each action takes only its own arguments.
- list: Who did what in the organization and its workspaces, newest first: sign-in settings, domains, members, SCIM, keys, asks and exports, each with who did it (a person, a key, a connected app, a service account, SCIM or 50heads). Filter by time, actor, event_action (an audit action or group) and workspace; page with next_cursor. Events never hold secrets, codes or anything that identifies a head. Organization admins only; needs audit:read. Arguments: from, to, actor, event_action, workspace_id, limit, cursor. Read-only; needs audit:read.
- export: The organization's audit events as JSON lines (one AuditEvent per line, the API's export shape), oldest first, with the same filters as action list. Returns up to max_events lines (default 1,000) and a resume_cursor for the rest. Each export is itself recorded in the audit log. Organization admins only; needs audit:read. Arguments: from, to, actor, event_action, workspace_id, max_events, cursor. Read-only; needs audit:read.

action.description: What to do. One of: list, export. Each action takes its own arguments; see the tool description.

actor.description: A person's user id, a service account id (sa_…), or system for 50heads itself.

cursor.description: list: next_cursor from the previous page. export: resume_cursor from the previous call, or the at|id of the last event you have.

event_action.description: An audit action (domain.added), or a group: organization, domain, member, sso, scim, question, billing, key, audit.

from.description: Events at or after this time (ISO 8601, or a date such as 2026-10-01).

limit.description: Events per page, 1 to 200 (default 50). Newest first. (Used by: list.)

max_events.description: Most lines to return (default 1,000). Oldest first; resume with resume_cursor. (Used by: export.)

to.description: Events before this time; a bare date includes that whole day.

name: audit

data.description: Details; never secrets, codes or anything that identifies a head.

jsonl.description: One AuditEvent (the API's shape) per line, oldest first.

resume_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the events after these; null when this is the end.

title: Audit log
